say:1:1311024001:1.text: This Hypofiend kept muttering about the Hierophant and a ritual...
say:1:1311024001:1.source_cn: 这个魔物一直在嘟囔什么“大主教”“仪式”之类的……

say:2:1311024002:1.text: I fear that what transpired at the previous two temples may repeat itself here.
say:2:1311024002:1.source_cn: “仪式”……我担心这里也出了和那两个小教堂一样的事情。

choice_prompt:3:1311024002.text: I fear that what transpired at the previous two temples may repeat itself here.
choice_prompt:3:1311024002.source_cn: “仪式”……我担心这里也出了和那两个小教堂一样的事情。

say:4:1311024003:1.text: That monster mentioned the Hierophant several times... Oh no! What if the Hierophant turned into a monster as well?!
say:4:1311024003:1.source_cn: 那个魔物好几次提到“大主教”……糟糕！要是大主教也变成...

say:5:1311024005:1.text: It's pointless to discuss the situation now. Let us go in and uncover what has transpired.
say:5:1311024005:1.source_cn: 现在这样的情况，讨论也没什么用了，进去看看就知道到底怎...

say:6:1311024006:1.text: Time is of the essence. Let us hurry.
say:6:1311024006:1.source_cn: 不能再耽搁了，我们赶紧走吧。

choice:3:0:1.text: The Hierophant may be in trouble.
choice:3:0:1.male: The Hierophant may be in trouble.
choice:3:0:1.female: The Hierophant may be in trouble.

say:8:1311024004:1.text: It's very possible... If we deal with the problem here, the time loop may end.
say:8:1311024004:1.source_cn: 很有可能……说不定我们解决了这里的问题，时间循环就会结束。

choice:3:1:2.text: Maybe the cause of the time loop is here.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 或许时间循环的根源在这里
choice:3:1:2.male: Maybe the cause of the time loop is here.
